name: env-toggle
description: OpenIDEA plugin: checkbox view for .env files. No dependencies; this file only holds the scripts.

scripts.screenshots: for t in light dark; do "${CHROME:-/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome}" --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --force-device-scale-factor=2 --window-size=1360,640 --default-background-color=00000000 --virtual-time-budget=3000 --screenshot=docs/screenshot-$t.png "file://$PWD/dev/screenshot.html?theme=$t"; done
